title: Lesson 23 · The safe on all your devices

lines.sub: This is Lira's Academy, lesson twenty-three — “The safe on all your devices”.
lines.tts: This is Lira's Academy, lesson twenty-three — The safe on all your devices.

lines.sub: I'm at the checkout, and the store password is back on my computer!
lines.tts: I'm at the checkout, and the store password is back on my computer!

lines.sub: It's on your phone too: “Safe” → “Copy”. In thirty seconds the clipboard clears itself.
lines.tts: It's on your phone too: Safe, Copy. In thirty seconds the clipboard clears itself.

lines.sub: On the computer, open “Password safe” and turn on “One safe on all my devices”.
lines.tts: On the computer, open Password safe and turn on One safe on all my devices.

lines.sub: Pick a master password. The key from it lives only on your devices — the server sees nothing but ciphertext.
lines.tts: Pick a master password. The key from it lives only on your devices — the server sees nothing but ciphertext.

lines.sub: On the phone — “All”, “Safe” and the same master password. Edit an entry on one — it changes on all.
lines.tts: On the phone — All, Safe and the same master password. Edit an entry on one — it changes on all.

lines.sub: The password is hidden: “Show” — for fifteen seconds. Put the phone away — the safe locks itself.
lines.tts: The password is hidden: Show — for fifteen seconds. Put the phone away — the safe locks itself.

lines.sub: Write the master password down: only you have it, and it can't be recovered.
lines.tts: Write the master password down: only you have it, and it can't be recovered.
